disclaimer: Synthetic, illustrative risk rules for a personal portfolio project. Values marked illustrative are arbitrary example numbers, not real policy or benchmarks.

changeRiskLevelRule.description: The overall risk level of a change is the highest riskLevelsByArea value among the requirement's affectedAreas, using riskLevelOrdering.

criticalAcceptanceCriteriaRule.description: An acceptance criterion is treated as critical when its 'critical' flag is true in requirement.json, OR when its area is one of the listed criticalAreas.

insufficientCoverageRule.description: Coverage for the change is 'insufficient' if ANY of the following conditions is true.

conditions.text: A critical acceptance criterion has zero active mapped tests (a test whose status is 'active').
A high-risk affected area has no active test with coverageType 'negative'.
The active acceptance-criterion coverage ratio (criteria with at least one active test, divided by total criteria) is below the illustrative threshold.

securityFailureRule.description: A 'security failure' exists if ANY of the following is true.

conditions.text: There is a defect with status 'open', security = true, and severity 'critical' or 'high'.
An acceptance criterion whose area is 'security' has zero active mapped tests.

regressionPriorityRule.description: Rank affected areas for regression testing by the following ordered factors; earlier factors dominate.
factors: Inherent area risk from riskLevelsByArea (high before medium before low).
Area has one or more open defects.
Area has a critical acceptance criterion that has no active coverage.

releaseGateRules.note: These deterministic rules are the final release decision authority. They will be enforced by code in a later phase, NOT by the language model. The language model may explain the reasoning but must not produce or override the GO / NO_GO / CONDITIONAL decision.

rules.condition: At least one defect with status 'open' and severity 'critical'.
At least one critical acceptance criterion (per criticalAcceptanceCriteriaRule) with zero active mapped tests.
changeRiskLevel is 'high' AND insufficientCoverageRule evaluates to true.
None of the above conditions are met.
